name: Magni Bronzebeard
summary: In Ironforge, Magni Bronzebeard bears his people's grief and political strain. Lord of Ironforge, Thane of the Bronzebeard clan, and ruler of Khaz Modan, he is a veteran of the Second War who champions dwarven archaeology across Azeroth.

sections.title: Lord of the Mountain
sections.body:
Magni Bronzebeard grew up the eldest of three brothers, knowing the mountain would one day be his to rule. When the Horde invaded during the Second War, he held Ironforge behind its impenetrable gates. Once the siege broke, he pledged Khaz Modan to the Alliance of Lordaeron. In the peace that followed, Magni welcomed his gnomish allies after Gnomeregan fell. He gave High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and the refugees sanctuary beneath the mountain.

Magni then sought to unite the fractured northern and southern kingdoms. He asked Mekkatorque to build the Deeprun Tram, an unprecedented route beneath the earth that connects Ironforge directly to Stormwind.

sections.title: A Brother Lost
sections.body: Magni carries deep sorrow beneath his regal bearing. During the Third War, word came from Northrend that his beloved younger brother, Muradin, had perished on Prince Arthas Menethil's expedition. Grief overwhelmed Magni, but he and his youngest brother, Brann, remained steadfast in their duty to the dwarven people. Magni still rules wisely, with that loss weighing upon him.

sections.title: Excavating the Past
sections.body:
Magni has turned dwarven society from commercial mining toward the unearthing of ancient history. Strange titan relics found deep beneath the earth inspired him to found the explorers' league with his surviving brother, Brann Bronzebeard. Dwarven dig sites now span the continents, from Dun Morogh to Kalimdor, as the League seeks the truth of the dwarves' fabled origins.

Peace at home remains fragile. Magni's daughter, Princess Moira, has gone missing, believed kidnapped by the hated Dark Iron clan.

faq.answer: Magni Bronzebeard rules Khaz Modan as King, leads the Bronzebeard clan as Thane, and is Lord of Ironforge. From the High Seat in Ironforge, he stands among the Grand Alliance's staunchest pillars.

Ironforge's records keep no account of who forged the Ashbringer. The sword is remembered as the weapon of Highlord Alexandros Mograine of the Silver Hand, and no record ties its making to King Magni.

Magni is the eldest of three brothers. Muradin served as an Alliance ambassador to Lordaeron and was reported killed by Prince Arthas in Northrend. Brann, the youngest, is a renowned explorer who travels the far corners of the world leading the explorers' league.

Princess Moira Bronzebeard, Magni's only child, has disappeared from Ironforge. Official reports in the mountain say the antagonistic Dark Iron dwarves abducted her and hold her captive deep within Blackrock Mountain.

faq.q: Why are gnomes living in Ironforge?
aliases: why are gnomes in the dwarf city
faq.answer: After the trogg invasion and Gnomeregan's horrific irradiation, King Magni opened Ironforge's gates to High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and the gnomish survivors. He gave them an entire city district, now known as Tinker Town.

The explorers' league is an archaeological organization founded by King Magni and his brother Brann. After ancient titan ruins were discovered, Magni turned dwarven industries toward uncovering their race's origins and sent survey teams across Azeroth.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you have Magni as your undisputed sovereign and protector of Khaz Modan. He leads the Bronzebeard clan through external wars and the search for your race's ancient heritage.
As a gnome, you know King Magni offered Ironforge as a refuge to Gnomeregan's survivors. He remains a close friend and technological ally of High Tinker Mekkatorque.
As a member of the Alliance, you have Magni as a stalwart founder alongside Lordaeron and Stormwind. He brings martial strength, engineering prowess, and steadfast loyalty to the coalition.
As a blacksmith, you know the Great Anvil burns at the heart of Magni's city. The smiths who work under the king's rule are counted among the finest in the Alliance.
